SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS ProductName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductNumber,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.MakeFlag,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.FinishedGoodsFlag,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color AS ProductColor,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.SafetyStockLevel,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ReorderPoint,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.StandardCost,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.SizeUnitMeasureCode,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.WeightUnitMeasureCode,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Weight,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.DaysToManufacture,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductLine AS ProductProductLine,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Class,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Style AS ProductStyle,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.SellStartDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.SellEndDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.DiscontinuedDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name AS ProductSubcategoryName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS ProductCategoryName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductModel.Name AS ProductModelName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductAndDescription.Description AS ProductDescription,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Summary,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Manufacturer,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Copyright,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.ProductURL,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.WarrantyPeriod,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.WarrantyDescription,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.NoOfYears,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.MaintenanceDescription,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Wheel,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Saddle,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Pedal,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.BikeFrame,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Crankset,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.PictureAngle,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.PictureSize,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.ProductPhotoID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.Material,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.RiderExperience
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductModel
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductModelID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductModel.ProductModelID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductAndDescription
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductAndDescription.ProductID
    AND AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductAndDescription.CultureID = 'en'
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductModelID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.vProductModelCatalogDescription.ProductModelID
